description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git log' and related functionalities, including Bloom filters, commit-graph management, and various pathspec handling scenarios within a Git repository. It includes setup procedures, test cases, and checks for different features related to Git's commit graph and log performance optimizations.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Defines and runs a command to verify the structure of the commit graph, specifically to check if the bloom chunks were written correctly.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository and sets up logs with and without Bloom filters for testing.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_used
methods.description: Checks whether Bloom filters are being used in 'git log' for a specific set of arguments.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_not_used
methods.description: Ensures that Bloom filters are not utilized in the 'git log' command for certain arguments.

methods.name: get_first_changed_path_filter
methods.description: Reads the bloom-filters from the commit-graph and returns the first filter, used to verify changed-path Bloom filter settings.

methods.name: check_corrupt_graph
methods.description: Corrupts the commit-graph with specified parameters and tests if Git handles the corruption appropriately.
